content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing the same problem and attempted your suggestion, but it didn't resolve the issue. I still can't access the [product_name] web server from my phone. Do you have any alternative solutions? I appreciate your help!

Hi, you mentioned you can access the web server from your PC, which is connected to the router via Ethernet cable. Your router also provides WiFi, but you cannot reach the web server with your mobile devices connected through WiFi. Try disconnecting the Ethernet cable from your PC and connecting via WiFi instead to see if you can access the web server. Verify all IP settings, including subnet and gateway configurations, to ensure they match. Adjust your router's DHCP range to exclude any fixed IP addresses from the DHCP allocation. Also, check if your router settings are blocking new devices (e.g., MAC filtering). Ensure your mobile device browsers permit access to unsecured web pages, or you won't be able to use this web server. Finally, test whether your mobile devices can access other devices on your WiFi network, as there could be relevant router configuration issues. Hope this helps.
The post you referenced is from 2018.
Resolved! The issue was that the [product_name] device was outside the IP range of both the WiFi router and my PC. Thank you very much for your assistance!

The main cause was found to be mismatched IP ranges among the devices. Troubleshooting included checking network settings and browser permissions on mobile devices.
